query: AMD client and gaming segment revenue Ryzen Radeon consoles
normalized: amd client consoles gaming radeon revenue ryzen segment

output.content:
AMD’s **Client and Gaming** segment generated **$14.55 billion** of revenue in FY2025 (year ended December 27, 2025), up **51%** from **$9.65 billion** in FY2024. [[1]] 

Within the segment, **Client** revenue—principally AMD Ryzen desktop and mobile processors—was **$10.64 billion** in FY2025, versus **$7.05 billion** in FY2024. [[1]]

**Gaming** revenue was **$3.91 billion** in FY2025, versus **$2.60 billion** in FY2024; AMD attributed the increase to higher semi-custom revenue, which includes game-console SoCs, and strong demand for Radeon gaming GPUs. [[1]] 

AMD does **not** separately disclose revenue for Ryzen, Radeon, or individual console customers/products, so the reported Gaming figure is the relevant disclosed aggregate for Radeon GPUs and semi-custom console chips. [[1]] 

In Q4 FY2025, Client and Gaming revenue was **$3.94 billion**, comprising **$3.10 billion** of Client revenue and **$843 million** of Gaming revenue. [[2]]

sources.title: AMD Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results :: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD)
